                    [32m'class Process:\r\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        self._http_client: httpx.Client = http_client\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +

                    [32m'        headers: dict[str, str],\r\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    ) -> None:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """Open a sync httpx_ws WebSocket, demux stdout/stderr until EOF, then close.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        The surrounding method is ``async def`` (callable via ``asyncio.run`` from sync code)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        so user-supplied callbacks may be ``async def`` and need awaiting. The httpx_ws session\r\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    @intercept_errors(message_prefix="Failed to create session: ")\r\n'[39m +

            [32m'CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS FOR USING THIS TOOL:\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'IMPORTANT: This tool is for terminal operations like git, npm, docker, etc. DO NOT use it for file operations (reading, writing, editing, searching, finding files) - use the specialized tools for this instead.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'  - If the commands depend on each other and must run sequentially, use a single executeCommand call with \'&&\' to chain them together (e.g., `git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push`).             [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Only create commits when requested by the user. If unclear, ask first. When the user asks you to create a new git commit, follow these steps carefully:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Git Safety Protocol:\n'[39m +

Taking unauthorized destructive actions is unhelpful and can result in lost work, so it's best to ONLY run these commands when given direct instructions \n"[39m +
            [32m'- NEVER skip hooks (--no-verify, --no-gpg-sign, etc) unless the user explicitly requests it\n'[39m +

When a pre-commit hook fails, the commit did NOT happen  — so --amend would modify the PREVIOUS commit, which may result in destroying work or losing previous changes. Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +

          description: [32m'Use this tool to create and manage a structured task list for your current coding session. This helps you track progress, organize complex tasks, and demonstrate thoroughness to the user.\n'[39m +
            [32m'It also helps the user understand the progress of the task and overall progress of their requests.\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'## When to Use This Tool\n'[39m +
            [32m'Use this tool proactively in these scenarios:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'1. Complex multi-step tasks - When a task requires 3 or more distinct steps or actions\n'[39m +

            [32m'3. User explicitly requests todo list - When the user directly asks you to use the todo list\n'[39m +
            [32m'4. User provides multiple tasks - When users provide a list of things to be done (numbered or comma-separated)\n'[39m +
            [32m'5. After receiving new instructions - Immediately capture user requirements as todos. Feel free to edit the todo list based on new information.\n'[39m +
            [32m'6. After completing a task - Mark it complete and add any new follow-up tasks\n'[39m +
            [32m'7. When you start working on a new task, mark the todo as in-progress. Ideally you should only have one todo as in-progress at a time. Complete existing tasks before starting new ones.\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'## Task States and Management\n'[39m +

                    [32m'class Process:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    """Handles process and code execution within a Sandbox."""\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    def __init__(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        language: str,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        api_client: ProcessApi,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        http_client: httpx.Client,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    ):\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """Initialize a new Process instance.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        Args:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            api_client (ProcessApi): API client for process operations.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            http_client: Shared httpx.Client whose connection pool the WS upgrade reuses.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self._language: str = language\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self._api_client: ProcessApi = api_client\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self._http_client: httpx.Client = http_client\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    async def _consume_log_websocket(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        url: str,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        headers: dict[str, str],\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        on_stdout: OutputHandler[str],\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        on_stderr: OutputHandler[str],\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    ) -> None:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """Open a sync httpx_ws WebSocket, demux stdout/stderr until EOF, then close.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        The surrounding method is ``async def`` (callable via ``asyncio.run`` from sync code)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        so user-supplied callbacks may be ``async def`` and need awaiting. The httpx_ws session\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        itself is sync — its blocking ``receive()`` is bridged onto a worker thread inside\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m"        :func:`std_demux_stream_httpx_ws` so we don't stall the event loop. The WS upgrade\r\n"[39m +
                    [32m"        reuses ``self._http_client``'s connection pool, sharing TLS context + DNS cache with\r\n"[39m +
                    [32m'        every other sync HTTP request the SDK makes.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        with httpx_ws.connect_ws(url, self._http_client, headers=headers) as ws:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            await std_demux_stream_httpx_ws(ws, on_stdout, on_stderr)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    @intercept_errors(message_prefix="Failed to execute command: ")\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    @with_instrumentation()\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    def exec(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        command: str,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        cwd: str | None = None,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        env: dict[str, str] | None = None,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        timeout: int | None = None,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    ) -> ExecuteResponse:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """Execute a shell command in the Sandbox.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        Args:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            command (str): Shell command to execute.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            cwd (str | None): Working directory for command execution. If not\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                specified, uses the sandbox working directory.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            env (dict[str, str] | None): Environment variables to set for the command.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            timeout (int | None): Maximum time in seconds to wait for the command\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                to complete.\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        Returns:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            ExecuteResponse: Command execution results containing:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m"                - exit_code: The command's exit status\r\n"[39m +
                    [32m'                - result: Standard output from the command\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                - artifacts: ExecutionArtifacts object containing `stdout` (same as result)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                and `charts` (matplotlib charts metadata)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        Example:\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            ```python\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            # Simple command\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m`            response = sandbox.process.exec("echo 'Hello'")\r\n`[39m +
                    [32m'            print(response.artifacts.stdout)  # Prints: Hello\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            # Command with working directory\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            result = sandbox.process.exec("ls", cwd="workspace/src")\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            # Command with timeout\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            result = sandbox.process.exec("sleep 10", timeout=5)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            ```\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        """\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        execute_request = ExecuteRequest(command=command, cwd=cwd, timeout=timeout, envs=env)\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        response = self._api_client.execute_command(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            request=execute_request,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            _request_timeout=http_timeout(timeout + 5 if timeout else None),\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        )\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        result = response.result or ""\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        artifacts = ExecutionArtifacts(stdout=result, charts=[])\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        return ExecuteResponse.model_construct(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            exit_code=(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'                response.exit_code if response.exit_code is not None else response.additional_properties.get("code")\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            ),\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            result=result,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            artifacts=artifacts,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'            additional_properties=response.additional_properties,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        )\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    @with_instrumentation()\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    def code_run(\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        self,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        code: str,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        params: CodeRunParams | None = None,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'        timeout: int | None = None,\r\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    ) -> ExecuteResponse:\r\n'[39m +

            [32m'Available agent types and the tools they have access to:\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'### guide\n'[39m +
            [32m"A comprehensive guide for learning about Pochi's capabilities, features, and configuration.\n"[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'Trigger examples:\n'[39m +

            [32m'- Help & feedback: "join the discord", "report a bug", "where can I get help?"\n'[39m +
            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'Engage this agent to formulate comprehensive, technical implementation strategies for feature development, system refactoring, or defect resolution.\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
